source_text: However, this framing overlooks its preventive classification in contexts analogous to vaccines, where interventions target rare but severe outcomes with net benefits; for instance, systematic reviews affirm circumcision reduces UTI risk by 90% in infancy and heterosexual HIV acquisition by 50-60% based on randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in high-prevalence settings, benefits that scale population-wide despite low baseline risks. [1] [125]
